### The House toolkit is complete: 8 Claude Code plugins
-# All MIT, all public, all installed from one marketplace

**🧰 What you can do with them**
• 🍔 **token-eater** · put expiring AI credits to work on reviewed cleanup, in an isolated copy, ending in a draft PR it never merges
• 🛡️ **pro-gate** · a final review pass on a PR using the Pro model on your own ChatGPT account
• 🌐 **wsl-cdp** · drive your real logged-in Windows browser from Claude Code inside WSL2
• 📐 **design-rails** · keep agents on your design system, and measure tap targets, motion timing, and type hierarchy from the code
• 🎚️ **skill-tuner** · tell whether an edit to a SKILL.md or CLAUDE.md actually worked, with a paired comparison instead of a vibe
• 🌙 **memory-dream** · an operator-gated consolidation pass over Claude Code's auto-memory, approved note by note
• 🔍 **harness-vet** · read a third-party skill the way an adversary would, before you install it
• 🧾 **rent-check** · find out what your always-on context costs per prompt, and which rules earn it

-# 🚪 First time: `/plugin marketplace add https://github.com/StartupBros-com/hov-marketplace.git`
-# 📦 Then install any tool: `/plugin install <name>@hov`
-# 🔔 New versions land in #📦│tool-drops. Turn on auto-update in /plugin → Marketplaces → hov.
